title: Clawd X Digest
summary: Frontier AI & Agentic Tooling: Reports surface on OpenAI's upcoming 7–10T parameter model 'Astra', while Cloudflare launched Kitesurf, a lightweight Rust browser for AI agents running on Workers.
Tesla Terafab Infrastructure: Visual comparisons revealed the massive footprint of Giga Texas Terafab against global landmarks, touted as one of the most valuable industrial structures.
Developer Workflow Evolution: Community adoption grows for T3 Code with local subscription routing, alongside GitHub agent ecosystem tools like Agent-Reach and codebase-memory-mcp.
Portfolio Strategy & Market Insights: Financial analysis highlighted why individual investors under $10M should avoid institutional-style over-diversification in favor of core index ETFs.
Culture & Entertainment Highlights: Severance Season 3 production updates, viral career transitions into AI development, and notable pop-culture recreations made waves across the feed.

items.title: @niccruzpatane: Terafab Mass Scaling vs Global Landmarks
items.body: Visual size comparisons of Tesla's Terafab project against Giga Texas, the Pentagon, Apple Park, and Mall of America highlights unprecedented industrial scale for AI computing and hardware production.

items.title: @CloudflareDev: Kitesurf Lightweight Rust Browser for Agents
items.body: Cloudflare introduced Kitesurf, a Rust-based headless browser running on Workers that uses 3-7x less CPU and memory than Chromium for instant per-request agent execution.

items.title: @haider1: OpenAI Prepares 'Astra' Next-Gen Pretrain Model
items.body: Industry analysis indicates OpenAI's next frontier pretrain model 'Astra' (internally checkpointed as 'mewfour') is targeting 7–10T parameters with optimized inference costs.

items.title: @theo: Claude Code & Codex Subscriptions in T3 Code
items.body: Theo clarified subscription compatibility for T3 Code, confirming users can seamlessly bring their existing Claude Code and Codex subscriptions without extra fees.

items.title: @GitTrend0x: GitHub Agent Ecosystem Breakthroughs
items.body: A curated breakdown highlights viral GitHub agent infrastructure projects, including Agent-Reach for web data ingestion, OpenMontage for video synthesis, and codebase-memory-mcp for persistent graph memory.

items.title: @mattpocockuk: Code Context Exploration with /wait-what
items.body: Matt Pocock highlighted practical software development workflows using the /wait-what command to summarize module changes, syntax quirks, and recent file mutations.

items.title: @leto_bao: Portfolio Management & Over-Diversification Pitfalls
items.body: A detailed market critique argues that retail portfolios under $10M suffer from imitating institutional compliance diversification instead of concentrating in low-cost index ETFs and high-conviction liquid assets.

items.title: @AlphaSenseInc: SuperAnalyst AI Agent for Market Research
items.body: AlphaSense introduced SuperAnalyst, an always-on financial intelligence agent capable of executing multi-step research and automated portfolio monitoring.

items.title: @HypernativeLabs: Pre-Transaction Threat Interception in Crypto
items.body: Security researchers emphasized that effective institutional Web3 defense requires real-time transaction interception before on-chain asset movement rather than post-exploit forensics.

items.body: Rep. Thomas Massie shared historical home purchase data from 1996 to contrast single-income purchasing power and interest rate dynamics against modern housing market friction.
